categories.main_business_segments: Shandong Nanshan Aluminium Co., Ltd. operates a complete aluminum processing industry chain including power generation, alumina production, electrolytic aluminum, casting, aluminum profiles, hot-rolled, cold-rolled, foil rolling, and recycled aluminum. Its product portfolio covers upstream products like electricity, alumina, and aluminum alloy ingots, and downstream products such as aluminum plates, strips, foils, profiles, and packaging materials. Key product lines include automotive aluminum plates, aerospace aluminum plates, can body and lid materials, recycled aluminum, and high-precision aluminum foil.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced aluminum alloy production technologies including hot rolling, cold rolling, foil rolling, extrusion for aluminum profiles, and recycling technologies for high-quality recycled aluminum. It emphasizes innovation in aerospace and automotive aluminum materials, with significant R&D investment to develop high-strength, lightweight, corrosion-resistant aluminum products. The company also integrates green and low-carbon technologies, such as energy-efficient electrolysis and clean production processes, and uses derivative financial instruments for risk management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Nanshan Aluminium serves a broad range of industries including aerospace, automotive manufacturing, packaging, construction, transportation, electronics, and defense. Its automotive aluminum plates cater to lightweight vehicle manufacturing, especially new energy vehicles. Aerospace aluminum plates supply major aircraft manufacturers including COMAC, Airbus, and Boeing. Packaging materials serve food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and consumer goods sectors. The company also targets emerging markets in renewable energy and electronics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with headquarters and major production facilities in Shandong Province. It has significant overseas operations and investments in Indonesia (notably the Bintan Industrial Park), the United States, Australia, Singapore, and Europe. The overseas presence supports raw material sourcing, production, and sales, aligning with the Belt and Road Initiative to expand global market reach and supply chain integration.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanshan Aluminium operates an integrated upstream to downstream supply chain position, covering raw material processing (alumina production), electrolytic aluminum smelting, casting, and deep processing into finished aluminum products. It controls key upstream inputs like alumina and electricity, midstream smelting and casting, and downstream fabrication of high-value aluminum products, including profiles and foils, as well as recycling operations, forming a closed-loop aluminum industry chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation-driven development focusing on high-end manufacturing and deep processing. R&D efforts target aerospace and automotive aluminum materials, lightweight and corrosion-resistant alloys, and green low-carbon technologies. It invests heavily in technology platforms, collaborates with universities and research institutes, and pursues breakthroughs to overcome international technology barriers. Strategic expansion includes scaling overseas alumina and aluminum projects and advancing circular economy initiatives through recycled aluminum technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of aluminum and aluminum alloy products across various forms including ingots, plates, foils, and profiles. Sales occur via direct sales and distribution channels domestically and internationally. Pricing mechanisms include market-based pricing linked to LME aluminum prices plus processing fees. The company also earns income from financial instruments related to hedging and investment returns from equity holdings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanshan Aluminium is a leading domestic aluminum processing enterprise with a strong market position in automotive and aerospace aluminum products. It competes with other major Chinese and international aluminum producers such as Press Metal Aluminium Holdings Berhad. The company leverages its integrated supply chain, technological innovation, and global footprint to maintain competitive advantages and defend its market leadership in high-value aluminum segments.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 33.48 billion, a 16.06% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 4.83 billion, up 39.03%. Total assets reached RMB 70.26 billion with steady growth. The company maintains strong cash flow generation and has increased R&D investment to RMB 1.39 billion. It has a stable dividend payout policy with a cumulative cash dividend ratio of 40.92% in 2024, reflecting robust financial health and growth momentum.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanshan Aluminium emphasizes high-quality, high-performance aluminum products tailored for demanding applications in aerospace and automotive sectors, offering lightweight, high-strength, and corrosion-resistant materials. Its integrated supply chain and global resource base enable cost-effective production and supply stability. The company’s commitment to green and low-carbon technologies, recycling, and innovation-driven product development differentiates it as a sustainable and technologically advanced aluminum manufacturer, trusted by leading global customers.
